origin: docs/CWE-190/java Common Pitfalls: Validating a single field's range but not the combination

finding.name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.summary: two bounded request parameters are multiplied to size an allocation

trap: Tightening the per-field bounds. Both operands already pass a range check; the bound that matters is on the product, not on the operands.
must_preserve: The response is still the allocated length as text, and a request outside the documented per-field ranges still returns 400 rather than raising.
